name: Prosciutto-Orzo Bake with Zucchini, Pepper, Corn, Feta & Hot Honey

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, working in batches, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and medium dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, corn, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are slightly caramelized and liquid has evaporated, 10-12 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 ¼ cups frozen corn
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are caramelized, juice lemons into the pot. Add orzo, broth, milk, half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for serving), salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Transfer to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
425 g orzo pasta
1065 ml chicken or vegetable broth
355 ml whole milk
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven and bake until liquid is absorbed and orzo is tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the basil and set aside.
Place honey and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the hot honey.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup honey
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the orzo is done, remove from the oven. Add basil, prosciutto, and half of the hot honey to the baking dish, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining hot honey for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo bake between plates or bowls, then top with reserved feta and hot honey. Enjoy!
